title: 24 Midnight Sun IDW 2005 One-Shot Jack Bauer Kiefer Sutherland Photo Cover
condition_description: Light edge wear and a small corner ding; price-sticker residue on the back cover. See photos.
description:
24: Midnight Sun (July 2005), IDW Publishing - prestige one-shot based on the Fox TV series. Jack Bauer battles a terrorist attack on an experimental oil drilling installation. Written by J.C. Vaughn and Mark L. Haynes, art by Renato Guedes. Kiefer Sutherland photo cover. Squarebound, $7.49 cover price.

Condition: light edge wear with a small corner ding at the top right of the front cover; price-sticker residue on the back cover (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
